task.description:
Implement OIDC-35 (Company onboarding orchestration) per the design artefact at src/design/oidc35-onboarding.md. The feature branch feature/WF02-oidc35-20260528 already exists and is pushed to origin (Step 00 completed).

New files to create:
1. src/api/routes/onboarding.zig — HTTP handlers for POST /api/v1/onboarding, GET /api/v1/onboarding/:id, GET /api/v1/onboarding?hostname=
2. src/identity/onboarding.zig — Orchestration logic: saga execution with compensating actions, idempotency handling
3. migrations/NNN_onboarding_registry.sql — DB table for onboarding records (idempotency key, request hash, response cache, state)

Files to modify:
1. src/identity/service.zig — Add executeOnboarding, verifyRealmDiscovery, bindTenantHostname, getOnboarding, getOnboardingByHostname
2. src/main.zig — Wire new onboarding routes into the router

All function signatures and data types are specified in the design artefact. Follow the existing patterns in identity/service.zig, identity/registry.zig, and api/routes/identity.zig.

The Keycloak adapter (identity_provider) may not yet have provisionRealm/provisionUser/provisionClient methods — implement the onboarding saga using the existing adapter interface where possible, and wire through the manager. If adapter functions are missing, implement them in the Keycloak adapter provider.

Validation:
- zig build must exit 0
- zig build test must exit 0
- No 'error set' violations
- Commit and push to the existing branch feature/WF02-oidc35-20260528
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/onboarding is callable (returns 401 without auth, not 404)
All functions use prepared SQL statements, no string interpolation
Code committed and pushed to feature/WF02-oidc35-20260528
